desc: Factor each A_i; for every prime p dividing some A_i record e_i = v_p(A_i) and S_p = sum e_i (primes never dividing any A_i contribute F(p)=1 and are skipped).

For each prime p run the height DP over 0..S_p carrying a hit-zero flag, weight p^height at each position, transition h -> h±e_i in range, dedupe the ± when e_i==0; sum flagged end states to get F(p).
Multiply all F(p) mod 998244353; if no prime divides any A_i output 1.
